one_liner_zh: 楷登電子（CDNS）上季營收強勁年增24.23%，每股盈餘達2.11美元優於市場預期。
one_liner_en: Cadence Design Systems reported strong Q2 results with revenue up 24.23% YoY and EPS beating expectations at $2.11.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：每股盈餘（EPS）實際值 2.11 美元優於預估的 2.06 美元。
highlights_zh: 營收達到 15.8 億美元，年增率高達 24.23%。
每股盈餘（EPS）為 2.11 美元，優於市場預期的 2.06 美元。
核心 EDA 與 IP 業務受惠於半導體設計複雜度提升，需求持續穩健。
營運效率提升帶動獲利能力擴張。
highlights_en: Revenue reached $1.58B, representing a strong 24.23% YoY growth.
EPS came in at $2.11, beating the consensus estimate of $2.06.
Core EDA and IP businesses remain robust driven by increasing semiconductor design complexity.
Improved operational efficiency contributed to earnings expansion.
risks_zh: 高達 58.00 倍的本益比顯示評價偏高，對市場情緒轉變較為敏感。
總體經濟波動可能影響客戶的研發預算與軟體授權支出。
risks_en: High trailing P/E of 58.00 indicates a rich valuation sensitive to market sentiment shifts.
Macroeconomic volatility could potentially impact customer R&D budgets and software licensing spend.
ai_view_zh: 觀點：財報展現強勁成長動能與優於預期的獲利表現，釋出基本面穩健訊號。短中期對股價具支撐作用，但高本益比需要高成長持續兌現來消化。追蹤指標應聚焦未來幾季的營收成長指引及主要半導體客戶的研發支出變化。
ai_view_en: view: Results demonstrate strong growth momentum and an earnings beat, signaling solid fundamentals. This provides near- to mid-term support for the stock, though the high P/E requires sustained high growth to justify valuations. Key metrics to track include forward revenue guidance and R&D spending trends among major semiconductor customers.
